source: Chapter 672: Greater Trouble
target: Capitulum 672: Maius Incommodum

source: Translator: CKtalon
target: Interpretator: CKtalon

source: Upon hearing Padre Cali’s shout, Rhea raised her hunting bow and aimed an arrow wrapped in silver lightning at the clergyman in the complicated black robe.
target: Cum clamor Padri Cali audivit, Rhea arcum venatorium levavit et sagittam, fulmine argenteo involutam, in sacerdotem in intricata veste nigra destinavit.

source: Unlike when she had faced the cafe owner, Bunia, the anger in her eyes was even more pronounced now, and there was no hesitation.
target: Diversum, cum ante cauponem, Buniam, occurrisset, ira in oculis eius nunc etiam magis manifesta erat atque mora non exstitit.

source: The padre was blaspheming and apostatizing!
target: Padre blasphēmia faciebat atque fidem deserere conabatur!

source: At that moment, a slender and powerful palm appeared in front of Rhea’s hunting bow, blocking the arrow.
target: Illo momento, palma tenuis atque fortis ante arcum venatorium Rheae apparuit, sagittam obstruens.

source: “You…” Rhea turned to Louis Berry, puzzled as to why he had stopped her.
target: "Tu..." Rhea ad Ludovicum Berry se vertit, mirata qua de causa eum eam prohibuisse videbat.

source: Lumian replied calmly, “Let’s wait and see.”
target: Lumian tranquille respondit: "Exspectemus et videamus."

source: As the two of them conversed, Padre Cali revealed a wanton and flamboyant smile.
target: Dum inter se colloquebantur, Padre Cali risum licentiosum et ostentatium detexit.

source: He turned around and walked back to the cathedral with the Bible in his arms.
target: Se vertit et ad cathedralem cum Biblia in brachiis ambulavit.

source: The golden dome at the cathedral’s top and the statues and decorations on the outer walls dimmed under the crimson moonlight.
target: Cupola aurea in summo cathedralis, statuae autem et ornamenta in parietibus exterioribus, sub lumine lunari rubro obscurabantur.

source: After Padre Cali’s figure disappeared through the cathedral’s open door, Rhea looked at Lumian with a dark expression.
target: Postquam figura Padri Cali per ianuam apertam cathedralis evanuit, Rhea Lumian vultu obscuro aspexit.

source: “Why?”
target: "Cur?"

source: Lumian chuckled in response.
target: Lumian subridens respondit.

source: “After realizing that this place is suspected to be a dream, I’ve been pondering a question.”
target: "Postquam intellexi hunc locum somnium esse suspicari, quaestionem meditabar."

source: As he spoke, screams and piercing cries reverberated through Tizamo and the surrounding plantations, echoing through the dark night sky.
target: Dum loquebatur, clamores atque acutae voces per Tizamo et circumstantia praedia resonabant, in obscuro caelo nocturno replicantes.

source: “What question?” Rhea pressed.
target: "Quae quaestio?" Rhea instavit.

source: Without giving a direct response, Lumian said, “It’s almost certain that we’re participating in the Dream Festival.”
target: Nullo responsu directo dandum, Lumian dixit, "Fere certum est nos in Festum Somniorum participare."

source: “Under such circumstances, if you succeed in attacking Padre Cali, what will happen when the Dream Festival concludes and everyone wakes up?”
target: "Sub talibus condicionibus, si in oppugnatione Padri Cali successeris, quid fiet cum Festum Somniorum finietur et omnes evigilabunt?"

source: Without waiting for Rhea’s response, Lumian smiled again.
target: Ne responsum Rheae exspectans, Lumian iterum subridet.

source: “If you shoot him in the arm, he’ll wake up feeling phantom pain in the corresponding location, as if he’s suffering from arthritis and his muscles are tearing.”
target: "Si eum in brachium iaculaberis, expergisci sensit dolorem phantasmaticum in loco congruenti, quasi arthritidem patitur et musculi eius laniantur."

source: H
target: H

source: “If you strike his head with a hammer and knock him out, there’s a high chance that he’ll have a headache, dizziness, and nervous twitches when he returns to reality.”
target: "Si caput eius malleo percusseris et eum concutias, magna verisimilitudo est eum, ut capitis dolorem, vertiginem atque tremores nervosos patiat, cum in rem reverterit."

source: “If you rape and impregnate him, he’ll likely feel nauseous, reflux, and bloated, feeling like he might have a fetus in his stomach when he wakes up.”
target: "Si eum violabis atque incubeberis, verisimile est eum nauseatum, refluxum et tumescens sentire, quasi fetus in ventre suo haberet postquam expergisceretur."

source: “If you tie him up, continuously electrocute him, and incinerate him with fire, will he feel those sensations in the real world, as if possessed by wraiths or shadows. He may always feel restrained, paralyzed, or in pain.”
target: "Si eum alligas, continue per ictus electricos affligas, et igne cremabis, num illa sensa in mundo reali sentiet, quasi a phantasmatibus vel umbris possessus? Fortasse semper se coarctatum, paralyticum aut in dolore sentiet."

source: Rhea listened calmly, not bothering to question why Padre Cali could get pregnant.
target: Rhea tranquille auscultabat, non curans quaerere cur Padre Cali gravida fieri posset.

source: The more she listened, the more alarmed she became.
target: Quo magis auscultabat, eo magis territa facta est.

source: This was because Louis Berry’s description matched the various manifestations of mass hysteria in Tizamo that the patrol team had gathered.
target: Hoc erat, quia descriptio Ludovici Berry conveniebat variis signis hysteriae massivae in Tizamo, quas turma vigiliarum congregaverat.

source: Lumian turned to Rhea and asked with a smile, “If you had killed Padre Cali with an arrow, what would happen when the dream recedes?”
target: Lumian ad Rheam se vertit et subridente rogavit: "Si Padrem Cali sagittā interfecisses, quid accideret cum somnium recederet?"

source: “He’ll die immediately? No…” Rhea denied it.
target: "Mox morietur? Non..." Rhea negavit.

source: Tizamo had no incidents of multiple people suddenly dying in their dreams after a night.
target: In Tizamo casus non fuerunt quo plures homines simul in somniis post noctem perire possent.

source: Rhea immediately thought of an abnormality.
target: Rhea statim de re insolita cogitavit.

source: Between mid-December and mid-March, 80% of the annual deaths in Tizamo occurred, significantly surpassing those in Port Pylos and the surrounding towns.
target: Inter medium Decembrem et medium Martium, 80% mortalitatum annuarum in Tizamo evenit, valde superans eas in Port Pylos et oppidis circumjacentibus.

source: She changed her words.
target: Verba sua mutavit.

source: “They will gradually die in an irreversible manner within the next three months?”
target: "Gradatim morientur in modo irreversibili intra proximos tres menses?"

source: With a nod, Lumian replied, “I even suspect that the primitive tribe in the forest launched several attacks in those three months mainly to eliminate those who had died in their dreams, allowing them to die reasonably in reality without revealing anything abnormal.
target: Clauso capite, Lumian respondit, "Etiam suspicor quod tribus primitiva in silva his tribus mensibus plures impetus iniit, praecipue ad eos, qui in somniis perierant, exterminandos, ita ut in re rite morerentur sine quidquam insolitum revelando."

source: “From December of last year to this year, they only completed one attack.”
target: "Ab Decembri anni praeteriti usque ad hunc annum, unam tantum impetum confecerunt."

source: The reason should be that the attack was very successful.
target: Causa esse debet quod impetus valde feliciter successit.

source: “Those who should die are dead, and some who don’t deserve to die are also dead.”
target: "Qui mori debent mortui sunt, et quidam qui mori non debent, etiam mortui sunt."

source: “There’s no need for them to take the risk and they also lost the motivation to come to Tizamo again.”
target: "Non opus est eis periculum sumere et etiam animos ad iterum Tizamo veniendum amiserunt."

source: Rhea listened attentively and pondered for a few seconds.
target: Rhea attente auscultavit et paucis momentis meditata est.

source: “The Dream Festival originates from that tribe?”
target: "Festum Somniorum ex illa tribu oritur?"

source: “It’s possible.”
target: "Possibile est."

source: “It’s more likely that they guard or worship the source and act according to its revelations,” Lumian replied simply.
target: "Verisimiliter magis curant aut colunt fontem et secundum eius revelationes agunt," Lumian simpliciter respondit.

source: Rhea nodded slightly.
target: Rhea leviter annuit.

source: “No wonder you stopped me from shooting Padre Cali.”
target: "Non mirum est quod me a sagittatione Padrem Cali prohibuisti."

source: “Everyone in Tizamo is likely a victim.”
target: "Omnes in Tizamo verisimiliter victimæ sunt."

source: Thats why I didn’t counterattack the two assailants and only killed the colossal boa with a single punch, Lumian thought.
target: Ideo duo aggressorum non repulsi, sed solummodo magnam boam colossalem uno ictu interfeci, Lumian cogitavit.

source: When awoken from the dream, will the colossal boa crawl in front of me and die?
target: Cum ex somnio expergiscar, num magna boa colossalis coram me serpet et morietur?

source: If thats the case, I can add more food to Ludwigs plate…
target: Si ita sit, possum cibum ampliorem ad Ludwig patinam addere…

source: Lumian surveyed the empty square slumbering in the night.
target: Lumian forum vacuum, nocte quiescente, perlustrare coepit.

source: “Let’s find Camus now and see if he’s still lucid.”
target: "Nunc Camum inveniamus et videamus an adhuc lucidus sit."

source: In Tizamo, on the third floor of the police headquarters, five rooms and one washroom belonged to the patrol team.
target: In Tizamo, in tabulato tertio praetorii vigilantium, quinque cubicula et unum balneum turmae vigiliarum erant.

source: One room was used for day-to-day work, while another was used for storing documents and items.
target: Unum cubiculum pro negotiis cotidianis adhibebatur, alterum vero ad documenta et res condendas.

source: The remaining three apartments belonged to the local patrol team members, one for each person.
target: Reliqua tria habitacula pertenebant membris localibus turmae vigiliarum, unum pro quolibet.

source: With the arrival of Camus and Kolobo, Maslow had temporarily moved to Loban’s to vacate a room for his colleagues from Port Pylos.
target: Cum Camus et Kolobo adventu venerunt, Maslow ad Loban transierat ad temporarie cubiculum liberandum pro collegis ex Port Pylos.

source: Clang! Clang! Clang!
target: Clang! Clang! Clang!

source: Amidst the reverberations of the bell, Camus jolted awake.
target: Inter resonantia campanae, Camus subito evigilavit.

source: He glanced out the window into the deep night, illuminated by a faint crimson moonlight.
target: Per fenestram in profundam noctem, levis lumine lunari rubro illustrata, conspexit.

source: Momentarily disoriented, he wondered about the hour.
target: Momento confusus, de hora quaesivit.

source: Just as Camus reached for his pocket watch, intending to check the time, he noticed Kolobo’s absence from the makeshift bed.
target: Iam cum Camus horologium suum ex sinu capere conabatur ut tempus inspexeret, animadvertit Kolobo ab lecto improviso defuisse.

source: A sense of unease washed over him, urging him into action.
target: Sensatio inquietudinis eum superveniens ad agendum impulit.

source: With silent determination, he rose from his bed under the eerie crimson moonlight, securing his pocket watch and weapon.
target: Tacita determinatione, e lecto surrexit sub lumine lunari rubro inquieto, horologium suum atque armum ceperit.

source: Stepping cautiously into the corridor, Camus found it unusually still, cloaked in shadowy silence.
target: Cautius in vestibulum intravit, et invenit eum insolite quietum, in umbris silentio involutum.

source: Beyond the confines of the police headquarters, eerie cries and distant wails pierced the night, emanating from various corners of Tizamo and its surrounding plantations.
target: Extra limites praetorii, clamores tenebrosi atque luctus procul per noctem penetraverunt, ex variis angulis Tizamo et agris circumstantibus emanantes.

source: Drawing on his keen awareness honed through experience as a Public Security Officer, Camus sensed a disturbance in his Jurisdiction.
target: Ex acuta vigilantia, per experientiam ut Officier Publicae Securitatis exercitatus, Camus perturbationem in sua iurisdictione sensit.

source: Suddenly, he instinctively dropped to the ground and rolled forward.
target: Subito, instinctu huic, in terram cecidit et se volvit ante.

source: A deafening crack echoed through the corridor as a wooden door, which Camus would have passed by, splintered and burst outward.
target: Fragor insons per corridor resonavit, cum porta lignea, quam Camus transiret, dispersa atque extrusa est.

source: In the blink of an eye, a broadsword slashed through the air, propelled by a savage force, slicing through the empty corridor.
target: In ictu oculi, gladius latus per aerem secabat, vi saeva impellitus, per corridor vacuum secans.

source: As Camus swiftly evaded the attack, he turned to face his assailant.
target: Dum Camus impetum celeriter evitavit, ad oppugnatorem se vertit.

source: It was Loban, the towering patrol member standing at over 1.9 meters, with short light-gold hair and piercing light-blue eyes.
target: Erat Loban, membrum vigiliarum excelsum, supra 1.9 metra stans, cum capillis brevi aureo-luce et oculis caeruleis penetrantibus.

source: A cruel smirk adorned the Feysacian’s face, his eyes glinting with unmistakable greed.
target: In facie Feysacii crudelis subrisio insita erat, oculi eius insigni avaritia micabant.

source: In the dim moonlight, his features were obscured by shadows, emanating an eerie malevolence.
target: Sub lumine lunari tenuimente, vultus eius umbris absconditus erat, nefandam malitiam efferens.

source: Upon spotting Loban, Camus’s eyes sparked with determination.
target: Loban conspecto, oculi Camus proposito ardore scintillaverunt.

source: Psychic Piercing!
target: Percussio Mentis!

source: Loban recoiled with a pained cry, instinctively shielding his head with his hands, relinquishing his grip on the broadsword.
target: Loban, gemitu maerenti retorsus, instinctive caput manibus protexit, et manum in gladio lato relinquens.

source: Seizing the opportunity, Camus swiftly drew his revolver, taking aim at his teammate.
target: Occasio captā, Camus celeriter revolver suum extraxit, in sodalem suum intuentem.

source: In a moment of hesitation, Camus faltered, then lowered his weapon.
target: Momento dubitationis, Camus titubavit, deinde armum deiecerit.

source: Bang!
target: Bang!

source: The bullet found its mark, striking Loban’s knee with brutal force, tearing through flesh and shattering bone.
target: Proiectum suam metam invenit, Loban genu vi cruda percutiens, carnem lanians ac ossa confracta.

source: A Doctor from the Church of Earth Mother could mend such injuries!
target: Medicus Ecclesiae Matris Terrae huiusmodi vulnera sanare posset!

source: Loban crumpled to the ground, writhing in agony, his attempts to curl up thwarted by the searing pain.
target: Loban in terram conlapsus est, et in dolore flexus, conatus se contrahere a dolore ardenti impeditos.

source: Camus lowered his revolver, rose to his feet, and pressed forward towards the end of the corridor.
target: Camus revolver deiecit, surrexit, et ad finem corridoris procedere coepit.

source: As he descended the stairs, Camus passed by a cluttered cubicle, its contents scattered haphazardly, and caught faint murmurs from within.
target: Scala descendens, Camus cubiculum varium reconditum pertransiit, cuius contenta confusa dispersa erant, et inchoatos murmurationes ex intimo audivit.

source: His heart skipped a beat as he whispered, “Kolobo, is that you?”
target: Cor eius paulum titubavit, dum sibilavit: "Kolobo, esne tu?"

source: A moment of tense silence followed before Kolobo’s voice, tinged with panic and fear, replied, “Stay back! Don’t come any closer! Spare me!”
target: Momento silentii tensionis secutum est, antequam vox Kolobo, cum terrore et timore tincta, respondit: "Recede! Noli propius accedere! Mecum parcere!"

source: Camus frowned, sensing that Kolobo’s demeanor was far from his usual composed self.
target: Camus vultum contraxit, sensu quod habitus Kolobo longe ab eo solito tranquillo distaret.

source: Though prone to bouts of fear and unease, Kolobo typically pushed through his anxieties to fulfill his duties.
target: Quamquam ad timoris et incommodi impetus inclinatus, Kolobo plerumque anxietates superabat ad officia sua perficienda.

source: This level of hysteria was unprecedented.
target: Talis hysteriae gradus inauditus erat.

source: What’s wrong with Kolobo? Camus wondered.
target: "Quid Kolobo habet?" Camus quaesivit.

source: Choosing to stay put rather than risk exacerbating the situation, Camus observed as Kolobo fell into an uneasy silence, as if attempting to fade into obscurity.
target: Manere potius quam periculum augendi casum caperet, Camus aspexit Kolobo in incommodum silentium incidere, quasi in oblivionem evanescere conanti.

source: After more than ten seconds, Camus contemplated assessing Kolobo’s condition.
target: Post plus quam decem secundis, Camus de statu Kolobo cogitavit.

source: If it proved dire, he resolved to retreat and seek out Louis Berry.
target: Si pessimum inveniret, decrevit recedere et Ludovicum Berry quaerere.

source: Suddenly, the sound of two sets of rapid footsteps echoed from below.
target: Subito, sonus duplicatorum rapidorum graduum deorsum resonavit.

source: Camus swiftly pivoted, training his revolver down the stairs.
target: Camus celeriter se vertit et revolver suum ad gradus dirigebat.

source: There, he beheld Louis Berry, sporting a golden straw hat, accompanied by Rhea, armed with a hunting bow and arrow.
target: Ibi invenit Ludovicum Berry, galeam ex stramine auro pictam gerentem, comitante Rhea, armata arcum venatorium et sagittam.

source: Gazing at the barrel aimed in their direction, Louis Berry chuckled lightly, his tone calm.
target: Spectans tubum in eorum directionem intendentem, Ludovicus Berry leviter subridens loquebatur, tono tranquillo.

source: “Welcome to the Dream Festival.”
target: "Salve ad Festum Somniorum."

source: The Dream Festival?
target: Festum Somniorum?

source: Its the Dream Festival?
target: Estne Festum Somniorum?

source: Realization dawned on Camus.
target: Revelatio Camusi innotuit.

source: He glanced between the smiling Louis Berry and the serious Rhea, confusion etched on his features.
target: Inter risum Ludovici Berry et severam Rheam conspexit, vultus eius perplexitate notato.

source: “Why are we still lucid?”
target: "Cur adhuc lucidi sumus?"

source: Observing their composed demeanor, Camus deduced that they hadn’t succumbed to the overwhelming emotions and desires that often engulfed dreamers.
target: Eorum habitum compositum aspiciens, Camus concludit eos non subesse affectibus et cupiditatibus vehementibus, quae somniatores saepe opprimerent.

source: Yet, he kept his revolver steady, wary of any sudden developments.
target: Tamen revolver suum firmiter tenuit, cautus ne quid subito eveniat.

source: “Perhaps our early entry into this peculiar dream, thanks to Twanaku’s house, has granted us this lucidity,” Lumian proposed, offering his deduction.
target: "Forsitan initium nostrum ante tempus in hoc somnio peculiari, propter domum Twanaku, nobis hanc luciditatem concessit," Lumian proposuit.

source: Rhea seized the opportunity to suggest that encounters within the dream might hold sway over reality to some extent, sharing the conjecture with Camus.
target: Rhea occasionem adhibuit ut suggereret congressus intra somnium posse partim realitatem imperare, cum Camus suam coniecturam communicans.

source: Initially relieved that he hadn’t resorted to lethal force against Loban, Camus’s expression turned grave as he addressed his companions.
target: Primum solatus quod contra Loban virtute letali non adhibita esset, vultus Camus serio versatus est, cum comitibus suis loquens.

source: “The three of us aren’t the only Beyonders in Tizamo.
target: "Nos tres non solum Beyonders in Tizamo sumus.

source: “If we adhere to the notion that we can’t retaliate when attacked, it will severely hamper our ability to defend ourselves.”
target: "Si instanter credamus nos, cum oppugnabimur, non posse repugnare, id vehementer impediet facultatem nostram ad se defendendum."

source: Lumian smiled.
target: Lumian subridens arridit.

source: “Who said we can’t kill?
target: "Quis dixit nos ne possimus interficere?

source: “If someone poses a threat to me, they shall be killed accordingly.”
target: "Si quis mihi periculum efficiat, interficietur pro tanto."

source: Rhea and Camus fell silent.
target: Rhea et Camus silentium ceperunt.

source: After a moment of contemplation, Camus nodded decisively, gesturing towards the sundry compartment nestled in the stairwell.
target: Post momentum meditationis, Camus firmiter annuit, ad compartimentum diversum in scala situm demonstrans.

source: “Kolobo’s extreme reaction stems from fear.
target: "Exremum Kolobo responsum ex timore provenit.

source: “He won’t pose a threat to us.
target: "Non nobis periculum faciet.

source: “Let him seek refuge there, undisturbed.”
target: "Ei ibi refugium quaerat, inturbatus."

source: As Rhea concurred, Lumian’s expression suddenly shifted.
target: Cum Rhea assentit, vultus Lumian subito mutatus est.

source: He asked, “Is Kolobo also in this dream?”
target: Rogavit: "Num Kolobo etiam in hoc somnio existit?"

source: Kolobo, who has been in Tizamo for less than a week like me, has also been forced to participate in the Dream Festival?
target: Kolobo, qui in Tizamo minus quam hebdomadas, sicut ego, mansit, etiam coactus est Festum Somniorum participare?

source: “Yes.”
target: "Ita."

source: Camus asked in confusion, “Is there a problem?”
target: Camus, confusus, rogavit: "Estne quaestio?"

source: A shadow crossed Lumian’s features as he responded gravely.
target: Umbra per vultum Lumian transiit, dum graviter respondit.

source: “This suggests there may be a larger problem at play.”
target: "Hoc significat maius problema consistere posse."

source: Perhaps one more terrifying than the Dream Festival itself!
target: Fortasse unum adhuc terribilius quam ipsum Festum Somniorum!

source: Before Camus and Rhea could inquire further, Lumian abruptly interjected.
target: Antequam Camus et Rhea ulterius interrogare possent, Lumian subito interposuit.

source: “Wait here for me.”
target: "Hic exspecta me."

source: With that, he vanished from the stairway, utilizing Spirit World Traversal.
target: Hoc facto, ab scala evanuit, Spiritus Mundi Transitus utens.

source: Lumian reappeared on the second floor of the Brieu Motel, just outside his suite.
target: Lumian in secundo tabulato Brieu Motel iterum apparuit, prope conclave suum.

source: In the next instant, a piercing scream echoed through the air, filled with agony and terror.
target: In proximo momento, stridor acutus per aerem resonavit, dolore et terrore plenum.

source: It was Lugano..
target: Erat Lugano..
